Market values are priced at the close the snapshot carries: market_cap_usd_m = price x shares_m and market_cap_date = price_date, where shares_m is FactSet's company-level share count (the market_value endpoint's currentMarketValue divided by the FactSet close of its own date; SAP: FactSet shares_outstanding, ADR 1:1). FactSet's market_value endpoint posts a session's value only hours after the 19:58 New York routine runs (at 8 PM New York on 2026-10-08 it still carried the 7-Oct value), so it is stored for the audit (market_value_factset) and never copied as the market cap (owner, 2026-10-09: tables 22 and 23 always at the prior close).
